description: Website audit in one call: HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, clickjacking, cookies, mixed content), on-page SEO (title, meta description, h1, canonical, noindex, robots.txt, sitemap, Open Graph, structured data), static WCAG 2.1 accessibility checks (alt text, labels, link and button names, lang, zoom), server response time and page weight, and the tech stack. Findings with severity and a 0-100 score per section. Repeat audits list what changed since the previous one. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.
